title: utv for Python component diagram
description: The Python library: the utv package and the tests that check it against the repository's shared conformance material and Python's own date/time API.

components.name: utv for Python
components.responsibility: The library: one setuptools project with no dependencies.

components.name: utv package
components.responsibility: The typed layer, the JSON layer, validation, native adapters and the bundled schema.

components.name: Tests
components.responsibility: unittest suites for the shared fixtures, the typed layer, the adapters and purity, and the UTV-first and native-first example suites.

components.name: Shared conformance material
components.responsibility: The everyday and text-form fixtures, the structural examples and the demo zone rules, read in place by the tests.

components.name: Structural schema
components.responsibility: schema/utv-1.0.schema.json, which the package's bundled copy must equal.

components.name: datetime, zoneinfo, calendar and json
components.responsibility: Python's standard date/time API, which the adapters convert to and from and the examples compare with. zoneinfo reads this machine's tz database.

components.name: unittest
components.responsibility: The standard library's test framework; every test is a unittest.TestCase.

relationships.description: src/utv, built by setuptools from src/.
Run with PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
Read operations/everyday.json, operations/text-form.json, examples/*.json and rules/demo-zones.json from the repository root.
Compare utv-1.0.schema.json byte for byte with the bundled copy.
The examples compare UTV with datetime, zoneinfo, calendar and json.
utv.native converts date, time, datetime and timedelta, using only ZoneInfo objects the caller made.
